in_marathi.name: Pankesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu's symbol
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pankesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Pankesh is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘pan’ meaning all and ‘kesh’ meaning hair. This name signifies the divine symbol of Lord Vishnu, whose hair is considered to be the universe. It is also believed that the name Pankesh is a manifestation of the god's protection and power.
